title: Accumulate a shared gradient
scope: Specified shared scalar computation and loss

items.prompt: Shared parameter w=1: a=w·2, b=w+a, loss L=0.5 b². Compute dL/dw, accumulating BOTH uses of w.
items.solution: b=3w; db/dw=1+2=3. dL/dw=b·3=9. Dropping either path loses a contribution.

items.prompt: Shared time weight w=0.5: a=w·2, b=w·a, target=1, L=0.5(b−target)². Compute dL/dw, including both occurrences of w. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: b=w²x, db/dw=2wx. Thus dL/dw=(b−target)2wx=-1.0. Stopping the gradient through a misses one contribution.
